text_simplified: The foundation of raising youth is instilling servitude to Allah the Exalted in their hearts and nurturing their natural disposition (fitrah), through which parents earn the reward of guiding to good, as the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever guides to a good deed will have a reward similar to that of its doer" (Sahih Muslim 1893). Both father and mother are in an act of worship to Allah during upbringing, teaching, spending, and bringing joy to their children when they seek Allah's reward; the Prophet ﷺ said: "A dinar you spent in the way of Allah, a dinar you spent to free a slave, a dinar you gave in charity to a needy person, and a dinar you spent on your family—the greatest of them in reward is the one you spent on your family" (Sahih Muslim 995).
